# Omar Osama

> Omar Osama is a digital creator in Cairo, Egypt, building websites, brand identities, visual content, presentations and AI-assisted creative work.

Omar Osama is based in Cairo, Egypt. He works across websites and front-end development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), brand identity and logos, social media content, product photography, presentations and generative AI-assisted creative work. Languages: Arabic and English. Contact: omar.osama2011@yahoo.com, WhatsApp +20 12 00140223.

## Work
- [NileSip Botanicals website](https://web-site11.github.io/NileSip/index%2012234.html): beverage brand website with flavors, offers, cart and ingredients story, plus brand presentation and product photography.
- [NEO GEAR brand guidelines (PDF)](https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/assets/neo-gear-brand-guidelines.pdf): identity system for smart sports accessories and gym equipment.
- [Aura Skincare brand board](https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/assets/aura-board.webp): logo system and brand board for a premium organic skincare brand.
- [FLAGVERSE](https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Game/): interactive web game for guessing country flags.
- [Local Two-Player Chess](https://omar-osama-ali.github.io/Chess/): minimal local multiplayer chess for the browser.
